title: Critical Apache HTTP Server Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild to Gain Remote Code Execution
content_md: Attackers are reportedly exploiting CVE-2026-119618, a critical vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server’s HTTP/2 module that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. The Cyber Security Agency of Singapore warned on November 17 that exploitation was underway and that a public proof of concept was available.
